resources.string: Scan bank, debit, and credit SMS alerts, track income & expenses, and generate loan disbursement sheets—100% offline and isolated per account.
LedgerPulse reads your SMS inbox locally on-device to detect bank, debit, and credit alerts. All records stay offline inside the signed-in user\'s private local vault.
